title: Speech submitted
description: On stdout: text was submitted to the AI-TTS daemon to be synthesized for the browser (playback false). Never the text.

kind.description: The program (or, for the bridge, the message type) that printed the line.

run.description: One id per invocation (for the bridge, per process), on every line it prints: a random (version 4) UUID.

at.description: When the line was printed, UTC.

state.description: The daemon's state for the utterance, as it reported it.

segments.description: How many segments the daemon split it into.
